Any handler or dispatcher path that reads u.Prefs dereferences nil: updatePrefs (api/users.go, p := *u.Prefs), notify SendNow (u.Prefs.Channel), and notify.message (u.Prefs.Lang).\n\nFix: ImportUsers sets DefaultPrefs() when the imported user has none. Reproducer: store/regress_test.go TestImportUsersGivesDefaultPrefs.\n\nReports: cr_910208 (x2, updatePrefs); cr_ec8ec7 (x2, SendNow, fp_ed8822); cr_616ab6 (x2, message, fp_442d26)."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "Weekly.Next returns a time before its argument in zones ahead of UTC"
                 fingerprint: "fp_ee7a52"
                 body: "Cause: schedule/weekly.go Weekly.Next used local.Truncate(24h). Truncate works on the absolute time, so it returns a UTC midnight, which can be the previous local calendar day in zones ahead of UTC. The next occurrence can then fall before `after`. BuildDigest (notify/text.go) computes a negative day index from it and panics (index [-1]). The v1.3.2 form (index [7] with length 7) is the same bug.\n\nFix: Next starts from the local calendar date. Reproducer: schedule/regress_test.go TestWeeklyNextIsAfterInZoneAheadOfUTC (Europe/Paris, Sunday schedule, Monday 01:00 start; original returns the Sunday before).\n\nReports: cr_089bc5 (x2, v1.4.0), cr_134867 (x2, v1.3.2)."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "Weekly reminder with an unknown time zone is stored with no zone and crashes the list"
                 fingerprint: "fp_81cd67"
                 body: "Cause: api/reminders.go createReminder passed schedule.LookupZone(...) straight to schedule.Parse. LookupZone returns nil for an unknown name, so the Weekly rule was stored with a nil Zone. Later, GET /v1/reminders marshals it, and Weekly.MarshalJSON (schedule/weekly.go) dereferences the nil zone.\n\nFix: createReminder returns 400 when the zone is unknown. Reproducer: api/regress_test.go TestCreateRejectsUnknownZone.\n\nReports: cr_d8878a (x3)."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "Unknown time zone saved in prefs makes the daily digest panic"
                 fingerprint: "fp_5b6f14"

  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "Data race on the dispatcher's retry map in Status"
                 fingerprint: "fp_5da03b"
                 body: "Cause: notify/notify.go Status read len(d.retries) without a lock, while flush and forget changed the map under d.mu. The race detector reports it on every admin status call during a flush.\n\nFix: retries is guarded by its own lock, retryMu, which flush, forget and Status take. Reproducer: notify/regress_test.go TestStatusConcurrentWithForget (run with -race).\n\nReports: cr_d241d2 (x245)."
  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "Dispatcher deadlocks against the store: flush holds d.mu while forget waits for it"
                 fingerprint: "fp_8058ef"
                 body: "Cause: lock-order inversion. Dispatcher.flush holds d.mu and calls store.MarkSent, which takes the store lock. store.Update holds the store lock and calls the OnChange hook, Dispatcher.forget, which takes d.mu. A snooze or edit during a flush deadlocks both, and requests stop after 30s.\n\nFix: retry state is guarded by retryMu, a leaf lock that is never held across store calls. forget takes only retryMu. Reproducer: notify/regress_test.go TestForgetDoesNotWaitForFlush.\n\nReports: cr_ea1512, cr_85335e."
